leadText:
An Aroma Lady (Japanese: アロマなおねえさん Aroma Lady) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation III games. They are generally depicted as young women surrounded by swirling flower petals.

They tend to specialize in , especially and its evolutionary relatives, as well as other Pokémon known for their smells. Their introductions often mention scents or aromas.

==In animation==
 
An Aroma Lady with the appearance of the ones found in Sinnoh made a cameo appearance in the opening sequence of Arceus and the Jewel of Life.
 

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
In Verily Vanquishing Vileplume I, Aroma Lady Rose (Japanese: ヤヨイ Yayoi) was one of the Trainers that traveled to the to participate in the Battle Dome tournament. In the fifth battle of the first round, she faced but was defeated.

==== ====
In Bombastic Bibarel & Heroic Hippopotas, an Aroma Lady appeared at the Seven Stars Restaurant.

==== ====
An Aroma Lady appeared as a background character in Deprogramming Porygon-Z, where she was part of a group of people who entered the after Palmer had his assistants open the gates. Another Aroma Lady was seen amongst the people waiting in line for the Battle Castle.

==== ====
 , a student at the Aspertia City Trainers' School, is based on the Aroma Lady Trainer class from .

=====Pokémon=====
 

Rose has at least two other Pokémon, as she participated in the Battle Dome tournament, which required participants to have three Pokémon on hand.

 

 

 

==In the TCG==
 
 
Aroma Lady was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese subset before debuting in English in the expansion, with artwork by Megumi Mizutani. It was also released as a and in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by En Morikura. It allows the player to attach draw two cards, then heal their Active Pokémon's s.
